file: File:John D. Rockefeller 1885.jpg
name: rockefeller.jpg
alt: Studio portrait photograph of John D. Rockefeller, founder of Standard Oil, in a dark suit.
caption: John D. Rockefeller (1839-1937). Public domain.

file: File:Breaker boys working in Ewen Breaker of Pennsylvania Coal Co. For some of their names see labels 1927 to 1930. LOC nclc.01129.jpg
name: breaker_boys.jpg
alt: Sepia group portrait of several dozen coal workers posed outside a Pennsylvania coal breaker - many of them boys, standing among the adult men, all in work clothes and caps.
caption: Breaker boys and men, Pennsylvania Coal Co. Photo Lewis Hine. Public domain (Library of Congress).

file: File:Chutes Loading the Canal Boats on the Lehigh Canal.jpg
name: lehigh_canal.jpg
alt: Nineteenth-century engraving of wooden chutes running down a wooded hillside to load anthracite into flat canal boats on the Lehigh Canal, with a boatman in the foreground.
caption: Chutes loading coal boats on the Lehigh Canal (opened 1827). Period engraving. Public domain.

file: File:Depiction of a Susquehannock on the Smith Map (1624).jpg
name: susquehannock.jpg
alt: Engraved figure of a Susquehannock man from John Smith's 1624 map of Virginia, shown standing with a bow, a club and a quiver, wearing a fur robe.
caption: A Susquehannock man, from John Smith's map of Virginia (1624). Public domain.
note: The earliest European depiction; treat as a colonial representation, not a neutral record.

file: File:Bethlehem Steel Corporation, Lackawanna Plant, Route 5 on Lake Erie, Buffalo, Erie County, NY HAER NY,15-LACK,1-126.tif
name: lackawanna_steel.jpg
alt: Large-format interior photograph of the Bethlehem Steel plant at Lackawanna, Buffalo: a long mill hall receding into the distance under overhead cranes, with rail track and machinery along its length.
caption: Inside the Lackawanna plant, Buffalo. Public domain (HAER, Library of Congress).
note: Source file is a .tif; the script downloads a scaled JPEG thumbnail, so the local name is .jpg.

file: File:Ruins Ludlow Colony - Trinidad, Col. LCCN2014695836.jpg
name: ludlow_ruins.jpg
alt: Photograph of the burned-out Ludlow tent colony in Colorado after the April 1914 attack: charred ground, twisted iron bedsteads and collapsed tent frames, with people standing among the wreckage.
caption: Ruins of the Ludlow tent colony, Colorado, April 1914. Public domain (Library of Congress).

file: File:Sid Hatfield c1920.jpg
name: sid_hatfield.jpg
alt: Portrait photograph of Sid Hatfield, chief of police of Matewan, West Virginia, in a suit and tie around 1920.
caption: Sid Hatfield, chief of police of Matewan. Shot dead on the McDowell County courthouse steps, 1 Aug 1921. Public domain.

file: File:Mother Jones 1902-11-04.jpg
name: mother_jones.jpg
alt: Portrait photograph of labour organiser Mary Harris 'Mother' Jones, an elderly white-haired woman in a dark high-collared dress and wire-rimmed glasses.
caption: Mary Harris "Mother" Jones. She was 83 in 1921 and urged the miners to stand down. Public domain.

file: File:Map of the movement of the union miners in Battle of Blair Mountain.png
name: blair_map.png
alt: Hand-drawn map of southern West Virginia marking Charleston, Marmet, Madison, Logan, Blair and Williamson, with arrows showing the movement of the union miners and a note reading 'Troops in Ohio and Kentucky held ready for action'.
caption: The miners' march on Logan County, August 1921. Public domain.

file: File:Blair-machine-gun-nest 0.jpg
name: blair_machine_gun.jpg
alt: Photograph of a machine-gun emplacement on a wooded ridge at Blair Mountain in 1921, with men in shirtsleeves and hats positioned behind the gun.
caption: A machine-gun nest at Blair Mountain, 1921. Public domain.

file: File:Blair-miner.jpg
name: blair_miner.jpg
alt: Photograph of an armed coal miner in work clothes and a hat during the 1921 Blair Mountain conflict, rifle in hand, a cloth tied around his neck.
caption: A miner of the 1921 armed march. Public domain.
note: Check whether the neckerchief is visible - it is the red-bandana 'redneck' detail.

file: File:Leaders of the Union During the Armed March in West Virginia Southern Coal Fields.jpg
name: union_leaders.jpg
alt: Group photograph of United Mine Workers leaders during the 1921 armed march in the southern West Virginia coalfields, men in suits and hats standing together.
caption: Union leaders during the armed march, southern West Virginia, 1921. Public domain.

file: File:Airfleet ordered to West Virginia Battlefield during the Blair Mountain fight 1921.png
name: airfleet.png
alt: Front page of The Washington Times, 1921, under the banner headline 'AIR FLEET ORDERED TO W. VA. BATTLEFIELD', with a sub-headline reading 'Aviators will drop bombs on marchers', above a map of the West Virginia coalfields.
caption: The Washington Times, 1921: "Aviators will drop bombs on marchers." Public domain.

file: File:Miners with bomb.jpg
name: miners_with_bomb.jpg
alt: Photograph of coal miners holding up an unexploded homemade bomb that was dropped on them from an aircraft during the Battle of Blair Mountain.
caption: Miners displaying a bomb dropped on them from the air. One such device became the defence exhibit at Bill Blizzard's treason trial. Public domain.

file: File:Bill Blizzard (Cropped).jpg
name: bill_blizzard.jpg
alt: Portrait photograph of union leader Bill Blizzard, who led the miners at Blair Mountain and was acquitted of treason against West Virginia.
caption: Bill Blizzard - tried for treason against the State of West Virginia, and acquitted. Public domain.

file: File:Pan-American Exposition - Electric Tower at Night.jpg
name: panam_electric_tower.jpg
alt: Night view of the Electric Tower at the 1901 Pan-American Exposition in Buffalo, its outline picked out by thousands of incandescent bulbs powered by alternating current from Niagara Falls, reflected in the water below.
caption: The Electric Tower at night, Pan-American Exposition, Buffalo 1901 - lit by AC sent 25 miles from Niagara. Public domain.

file: File:President Roosevelt - Pach Bros.jpg
name: teddy_roosevelt.jpg
alt: Formal portrait photograph of President Theodore Roosevelt in a dark suit, seated, by the Pach Brothers studio.
caption: Theodore Roosevelt. Public domain.

file: File:Colonel Roosevelt and his Rough Riders at the top of the hill which they captured, Battle of San Juan) - by William Dinwiddie LCCN96521936.jpg
name: rough_riders.jpg
alt: 1898 photograph by William Dinwiddie of Colonel Theodore Roosevelt standing among the Rough Riders and other US troops on a captured hilltop in Cuba, an American flag raised behind them.
caption: Roosevelt and the Rough Riders on the captured hill, Cuba, July 1898. Photo William Dinwiddie. Public domain.

file: File:Historic Pullman Houses on 112th Street (169408992).jpg
name: pullman.jpg
alt: Colour photograph of a row of surviving Pullman company rowhouses on 112th Street in Chicago today, their brick and timber fronts painted in different colours, with small front gardens.
caption: Pullman company housing, Chicago, as it survives today. Photo Richie Diesterheft, CC BY 2.0.
note: CC BY 2.0 - attribution MUST appear on the slide. The script will record the photographer's name in CREDITS.md; copy it into the caption.

file: File:Company store. Koppers Coal Division, Federal ^1 Mine, Grant Town, Marion County, West Virginia. - NARA - 540275.jpg
name: company_store.jpg
alt: Photograph of the company store at the Koppers Coal Division Federal No. 1 Mine in Grant Town, West Virginia: a large building with the company name across the front and miners' cars parked outside.
caption: The company store, Federal No. 1 Mine, Grant Town, WV. Public domain (National Archives).

file: File:Coal scrip from Killarney West Virginia.jpg
name: coal_scrip.jpg
alt: Close-up photograph of a metal coal-company scrip token stamped with the mine's name and a denomination, the private currency redeemable at face value only in the company store.
caption: Coal scrip, Killarney, West Virginia. Public domain.

file: File:Mary Garrity - Ida B. Wells-Barnett - Google Art Project - restoration crop.jpg
name: ida_b_wells.jpg
alt: Studio portrait photograph of journalist Ida B. Wells-Barnett, a Black woman in a high-necked dark dress, seated and facing the camera.
caption: Ida B. Wells (1862-1931). Public domain.

file: File:Leadbelly, National Press Club, Washington, D.C., between 1938 and 1948 (William P. Gottlieb 13561).jpg
name: lead_belly.jpg
alt: Photograph of the musician Lead Belly, Huddie Ledbetter, singing and playing his twelve-string guitar, taken by William Gottlieb at the National Press Club in Washington DC.
caption: Lead Belly (1888/89-1949). Photo William P. Gottlieb. Public domain.

file: File:The Ku Klux Klan on parade down Pennsylvania Avenue, 1928 - NARA - 541885.jpg
name: kkk_parade_1928.jpg
alt: Photograph of thousands of robed and hooded Ku Klux Klan members marching in daylight down Pennsylvania Avenue in Washington DC in 1928, with crowds watching from the pavements and the Capitol in the distance.
caption: Klan parade, Pennsylvania Avenue, Washington DC, 1928. Public domain (National Archives).
